description: This file defines the Ruleset class within the AWS SDK's EndpointV2 Ruleset namespace. It manages rules, parameters, and logic to resolve endpoints or errors based on input parameters, including evaluation and validation of rules and parameters.

classes.name: Ruleset
classes.description: A collection of rules, parameter definitions, and helper functions used to resolve endpoints or errors in the AWS SDK.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the ruleset.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Returns the list of parameters for the ruleset.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the ruleset against input parameters and returns the first matching rule evaluation or false.

methods.name: validateInputParameters
methods.description: Validates and sets default values for input parameters based on the ruleset definitions.

methods.name: createParameters
methods.description: Creates parameter objects from parameter definitions.

methods.name: createRules
methods.description: Creates rule objects from rule definitions.
